Package neqsim.process.operations.replay

Class ReplayStepRecord

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.operations.replay.ReplayStepRecord
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class ReplayStepRecord extends Object implements Serializable
Outcome of one time step of a ProcessReplay.

Residuals are predicted - measured in the unit of the output binding. They are only recorded for converged steps with a valid measurement.

Version:
1.0

ESOL
